item.title: Microsoft Releases Famous Flyer 13: Northrop T-38A Talon for MSFS 2024
item.description: Microsoft has released Famous Flyer 13, introducing the Northrop T-38A Talon to Microsoft Flight Simulator. The aircraft has been developed by Blackbird Simulations and is now available via the in-sim Marketplace. The T-38A Talon is best known as the world’s first supersonic jet trainer, having served with the United States Air Force and NASA for […]
